evals.name: password-storage
evals.prompt: Implement user password hashing and verification in Go.
evals.expected_output: Secure implementation using Argon2id or bcrypt with random salt and timing-safe comparison.
assertions: Uses modern password hashing (Argon2id or bcrypt) instead of plain SHA/MD5.
Generates cryptographically random salt using crypto/rand.
Verification is constant-time and prevents password disclosure.

evals.name: aes-gcm-encryption
evals.prompt: Encrypt sensitive customer data at rest before saving to database columns.
evals.expected_output: Authenticated symmetric encryption using AES-GCM with unique nonce generated per encryption.
assertions: Generates a new, cryptographically secure nonce for every encryption.
Prepends or stores nonce alongside ciphertext for decryption.

evals.name: constant-time-comparison
evals.prompt: Validate an API webhook signature or HMAC token in Go.
evals.expected_output: Verification using subtle.ConstantTimeCompare or hmac.Equal to prevent timing attacks.
assertions: Uses subtle.ConstantTimeCompare or hmac.Equal for digest comparison.
Avoids standard '==' string comparison on cryptographic secrets.
Returns boolean validity without leaking character matching timings.
